100% attendance is must.
Sir usually solve maths in white board & explains in each & every possible way for students. He also encourages everyone to find problems & utilize office hours of him & TA. After each class Sir gives Home Tasks for practices. He prefers two big separate "notebook" for practicing: one for doing maths in classes & one for doing the Home Tasks.
Sir also provide lecture slides. If anyone understands all the maths in slides(all of them Sir will solve in the class) & do all the maths from Home Tasks regularly then all the exams will be good for sure.
Sir usually take 3 quizzes, 2 Assignments(1 before mid & 1 before the Final) & 1 Mid. 
Sir not only give values your performance of course but also give values ones dedication & efforts.
End of the day, MLA Sir is always best.

As a result its nearly impossible to finish up all the course within a 4-5 year timeline at NSU for any department, but its possible if we make a proper planning ahead of our semesters.

Hopefully it will be helpful for the upcoming freshers who plans to complete the courses within due times. During 2023 and 2024, we had bi-semester system, which later shifted to a tri-semester in 2025 and 2026.

Spring 2023 (13.00 cr)
- CSE115+L, ENG103, MAT116, POL101
Summer 2023 (22.00 cr)
- BEN205, CHE101, CSE173, ENV203, HIS103, MAT120, MAT125, PHY107L
Intersession 2023 (4.00 cr)
- CSE215+L

Spring 2024 (20.00 cr)
- CHE101L, CSE225, CSE231, ECO101, EEE154, HIS102, MAT130, PHY107
Summer 2024 (19.00 cr)
- CSE311, EEE141+L, ENG111, MAT250, PHI104, PHY108

Spring 2025 (16.00 cr)
- CSE327, CSE332, CSE373, EEE111+L, MAT350
Summer 2025 (13.00 cr)
- CSE299, CSE323, CSE482, EEE452, MAT361
Fall 2025 (15.00 cr)
- BIO103, CSE331, CSE425, CSE445, CSE468

Spring 2026 (7.50 cr)
- CSE273, CSE465, CSE499A
Summer 2026 (3.50 cr)
- CSE498R, CSE499B, PHY108L

I have noticed a lot of people here at NSU specially from CSE major face difficulties making a course plan. Usually they pre-advise for courses that they most likely won’t get. Also most of the time people take fewer courses in their early semesters which leads to huge pressure during the later semesters. I have kept retake options for 2 courses if you need to improve in a couple of courses.
